barriers.description: Existing informational brochures had not been previously evaluated and lacked prior feedback from patients and healthcare professionals, leaving gaps in designers' evidence about acceptability and usability.
barriers.justification: This knowledge gap limits the designers' ability to manage user understanding, specify user requirements, and to plan effective evaluation and iteration of the materials before wider implementation.
barriers.reference_excerpt: The effectiveness of the brochures created so far has not been tested, and there is no hindsight or feedback from patients or healthcare professionals regarding their acceptability, usability and usefulness.

barriers.description: Regional variation in the number of cancer centers creates the need for specific regional coordination for data collection, adding logistical complexity for the research team.
barriers.justification: This operational constraint hampers designers' ability to understand context of use and to facilitate consistent participant recruitment and data collection across sites, which can impede evaluation and iteration workloads.
barriers.reference_excerpt: The number of cancers centers varies by region, requiring specific regional coordination for data collection.
